newsitem.title: UK: P.Duffryn says full-yr outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: P.Duffryn says full-yr outlook stable.

text.p: British ports and engineering group Powell Duffryn Plc said on Thursday it expected a satisfactory earnings outcome for the full year to March 30, after reporting a slight rise in its underlying earnings for the first half of the year.

"Against the background of some disposal-related earnings dilution and concerns about the construction sector, we anticipate a satisfactory outcome for the year as a whole," group chief executive Barry Hartiss said in a statement with the results which showed core operating profits rising to 22.2 million stg from 20.4 million stg in the year-ago period.
